name: Case page
about: Every element of every Case page state. Facts measured from the built web app at 390 wide (density-independent points); tokens are the ones the applying CSS rule references. Schema: see AGENTS.md.

rule.name: Calling — the whole call (`call.calling` 2 / 7a, `call.calling-transfer` 11) Status line "Calling {name}…" (D-74) only — no Callback on a live call (CW-A1, D-83). No separate Connecting / On call states (D-58 pt 14). No End call — the doctor ends the call on the phone
rule.pattern: case.back-blocked: N1 (not an error) — Call attempted or connected, case not closed. Header Back hidden from the call tap on; phone back gesture shows "Finish this case first. Then you can go back to Home." (D-81 F21).
rule.appLogic: App logic state table: Calling — the whole call (`call.calling` 2 / 7a, `call.calling-transfer` 11) — End-of-call script in the slot under Order details, above the medicines, from the tap (D-58 pt 18): Status line "Calling {name}…" (D-74) **only — no Callback on a live call** (D-83). No separate Connecting / On call states (D-58 pt 14). **No End call** — the doctor ends the call on the phone · Header Back hidden from the tap on Call patient / Call again (D-80, D-81 F21); phone back → toast "Finish this case first. Then you can go back to Home." (`a-back-blocked`)
